description: Local proxy that intercepts real DeepSeek requests from Copilot Chat and shows today's cost, token usage, and balance in the status bar (Beijing time).
config.statusBarFormat: Status bar display format: full (cost + tokens), cost, tokens, totalT (total tokens only), totalCost (total cost only), or balance (account balance).
config.title: DeepSeek Status Bar for Copilot
config.autoStart: Automatically start the proxy when VS Code launches.
config.manageBaseUrl: Point deepseek-copilot.baseUrl at the local proxy while running, and restore it when stopped.
config.pricing: Per-model price overrides (yuan per million tokens): an object keyed by model, each value {cache_hit, cache_miss, output}. Merged over the built-in defaults.
config.currency: Cost display currency: cny (￥) or usd ($).
config.cnyPerUsd: Fallback CNY per 1 USD for USD display, used when the live rate can't be fetched from the API.
config.lowBalanceWarnCny: Account balance (yuan) below which the status bar shows a low-balance warning. Set to 0 to disable.
